summary: [¶] Petition under Sections 62 and 79(1) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with related provisions of Chapter 5 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 1999 and Regulation 27(1) of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2019 for approval of proposal for Renovation & Modernization for life extension beyond the normal useful life in respect of Khandong Power Station (50 MW) of North Eastern Electric Power Corporation Limited, Shillong. [¶] The Petitioner, North Eastern Electric Power Corporation Limited, has filed the [¶] (c) The following problems are being faced at the power station, causing frequent outages of the generating units, which in turn is leading to substantial wastage of available water power potential: [¶] (iii) Inefficient/old design / obsolete valves, MIV, turbines and generators. [¶] (e) The Petitioner has prepared a Detailed Project Report (DPR) on Renovation & Modernization for life extension of the Khandong Power Station based on RLA & LE studies for some Electro-mechanical (E&M) and Hydro-Mechanical systems carried out by M/s. CPRI. [para 4] 4. During the hearing of the Petition on 2.7.2025, the representative of the Petitioner made oral submissions in support of the reliefs sought in the petition. However, on a specific query of the Commission with regard to the status of approval of the DPR by the CEA, the representative of the Petitioner clarified that the DPR submitted to CEA for approval on 4.8.2020, is under active consideration by the CEA, and approval is expected shortly. On an observation of the Commission that no purpose would be served to keep the matter pending, considering the fact that the DPR approval by CEA is awaited and that the anticipated COD of the Units (post-R&M) would fall during the period 2024-29, thereby requiring revision of the petition in terms of the 2024 Tariff Regulations, the representative of the Petitioner sought permission to withdraw the present petition, with liberty to the Petitioner to approach the Commission on this subject, after approval of the DPR. He also prayed for adjustment of the filing fees paid for the present Petition, against the Petition to be filed on the subject, in future. [para 5] 5. In view of the above submissions, the Petitioner is permitted to ‘withdraw’ the present Petition with the liberty to approach the Commission in the future, with a fresh petition, along with all relevant supporting documents. The filing fees paid in the present Petition will be adjusted against the Petition to be filed in the future, as stated above. [para 6] 6. Accordingly, Petition No. 633/MP/2020 is disposed of as ‘withdrawn’.
